title: Alarm Glyphs
story: The alarm board in the west hall has lost six punctuation labels, so two distinct alerts look identical. Hal, anxious about a real alert slipping past, asks for the exact glyphs: one card at a time, then shuffled, then an unseen mixed alert. When the six labels return, the board separates into six hues and a maintenance door opens.

steps.objective: Walk west along the mint conduit into the alarm hall.
Talk to Hal about the alarm board.
Go to the alarm label desk.
Restore the six alert cards, one symbol each.

dialogue.speaker: hal
dialogue.text: Six alarm labels are gone, so two different alerts look identical. I need the exact glyphs back before something real fires.

dialogue.speaker: engineer
dialogue.text: Journal: alarm board, six blank labels. Restore ! @ # $ % ^ one card at a time.

dialogue.speaker: alarm_card
dialogue.text: To mark the alert urgent, you need to press ! (Shift + 1).

hint.action: To mark the alert urgent, you need to press ! (Shift + 1).

dialogue.speaker: alarm_card
dialogue.text: To mention Hal in the alert note, you need to press @ (Shift + 2).

hint.action: To mention Hal in the alert note, you need to press @ (Shift + 2).

dialogue.speaker: alarm_card
dialogue.text: To tag the alert number, you need to press # (Shift + 3).

hint.action: To tag the alert number, you need to press # (Shift + 3).

dialogue.speaker: hal
dialogue.text: To prefix the cost variable, you need to press $ (Shift + 4).

hint.action: To prefix the cost variable, you need to press $ (Shift + 4).

dialogue.speaker: alarm_card
dialogue.text: To write the load as a percentage, you need to press % (Shift + 5).

hint.action: To write the load as a percentage, you need to press % (Shift + 5).

dialogue.speaker: alarm_card
dialogue.text: To raise the value to a power, you need to press ^ (Shift + 6).

hint.action: To raise the value to a power, you need to press ^ (Shift + 6).

dialogue.speaker: hal
dialogue.text: That is all six. Now the cards are shuffled, so you cannot lean on their order.

dialogue.speaker: hal
dialogue.text: Six alerts, six distinct colours. That settles me. The maintenance door unlocked too: it leads straight to the formula room.

dialogue.speaker: engineer
dialogue.text: Alarm strip: the old alert names carry an extra department that no staff request ever added.
dialogue.cue: Engineer concerned: inspecting a tampering artifact (Alarm strip)

then.text: Alarm labels restored. The maintenance door joins the alarm hall to the formula room.

state_changes.before: The alarm board shows six lights with blank pictograms, the maintenance door is shut, the alarm hall lamp is off and Hal fidgets with a loose cable.
state_changes.after: Six pictograms and six distinct light hues are on the board, the maintenance door is open, the lamp is on, the mint conduit is lit and Hal stands settled.

visible_changes.note: six pictograms return and each light takes its own hue

optional_artifact.name: Alarm strip
caption: A strip of alarm names from before the labels were lost.
Each name carries an extra department that appears nowhere in the current directory.
Someone added it without a staff request.

glitch.note: Optional untimed repair beside the label desk.

pace_copy.text: Alerts are acknowledged. Alerts are acknowledged.
